contract: Use current authenticated protected default commit/tree for policy/runtime/workflow/evaluator source, independent of semantic PR comparison.
Default-target comparison must still equal current protected default; preserve all valid default observation fields and legacy default evidence.
For a bound nondefault comparison, authenticate exact provider ref and commit/tree; add comparison metadata to evaluator identity while base continues to identify protected source.
Recompute that comparison at publisher consumption; movement, retarget, missing ref/object or wrong source rejects before check publication.
Finalizer rechecks PR binding and protected default after evidence reads; publisher rechecks them before mutation.
Nondefault PR certification is PR progress only: no default-main successor transition equivalence, protected merge, phase/controller/release/custody authority.
Generated executable checkout has already been separated to workflow-definition source; no installed adoption or activation is inferred by these unit controls.
compatibility: Previously valid default-target output remains byte-shape compatible. Newly supported previously rejected nondefault context adds evaluator.comparison. No CLI change. Existing default observations remain readable.
tests: bound nondefault finalizer/publisher use protected source and bind comparison tree
comparison movement between finalizer and publisher rejects
PR or protected source movement during evidence reads rejects
missing/wrong comparison reference and malformed tree reject before producer consumption
unchanged current-default guard and substituted evaluator identity remain enforced
